verdict.rationale: The docs show that several chats can connect to one Project and share its deployment, environment variables and production URL, and that a shared credit pool is split among team members. GitHub integration adds isolated branches and pull requests, which teams can use to work in parallel. Nothing explicitly describes a shared team workspace where members are invited and edit together, so collaboration has to be pieced together from these pieces. Missing for 10: documented team workspace with member invites and roles, real-time co-editing or shared chat access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team use.
